description: A valid typography scale declares heading and body steps with readable sizes, a base font size, and valid font weights.

rules.description: The scale must include at minimum h1, h2, and body steps. Without these, hierarchy cannot be established and cross-compiler checks fail.
At least one fontFamily must be declared. This is the source of truth for font stack generation across components.
Every step fontWeight must be a valid CSS value: 100–900 numeric or named keywords (thin, regular, bold, etc.).
A baseSize or base field must be declared so that the mathematical relationship between scale steps can be verified. Without it, the scale is opaque.
